environment: Isolated Next16.3.8 production HTTPS server; connected public catalog; Chromium, desktop WebKit and iPhone13-profile WebKit; one worker
limits: Firefox retains the documented local launch blocker and was not run.
iPhone-profile WebKit does not support mouse-wheel input; those cases verify document-scroll geometry programmatically. Native touch and bilingual screen-reader acceptance remain QA actions.
Desktop hover skips the touch profile; no business, financial, catalog or settings writes.
